name: We Belong Dead
source:
It has been far too long since you passed.
You have been gone for so long.
But no longer.
I will bring you back my love.
No matter the cost.


[We Belong Dead] is a Toxic Yuri Visual Novel between a mad scientist, and her spectral lover who haunts the living.

[From [url=https://uberthemeh.itch.io/we-belong-dead]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
距离你去世已经过去太久了。
你已经走了这么久了。
但不再是了。
我会把我的爱还给你。
不管成本如何。


《我们死了》是一部有毒的尤里视觉小说，讲述了一位疯狂科学家和她困扰生者的幽灵情人之间的故事。

[来自[url=https://uberthemeh.itch.io/we-belong-dead]itch.io[/url]]
